messages:
Alice Nguyen: FP8 bakeoff update — seeing a sudden hallucination + formatting pulse on csv->tablex evals after switching to compact FP8 profile.
Ben Kim: ugh. which workload? samples?
Alice Nguyen: batch: legal-csv-1000, seed sweep 42..45. AWQ+FP8 compact profile v2. Relative hallucination rate jumped from 0.6% -> 5.1% on table extraction tests.
Ciara Patel: any regressions on exact-match or just hallucination and field order?
Alice Nguyen: EM mostly flat (-0.2% diff), but structured key collisions and newline collapse in multiline cells. example:
```
input: "Name,Notes\nAlice,Senior eng\nBob,\"Relocated\n2020\"\n"
awq-fp8: "Notes: Senior eng Bob Relocated 2020"  <-- merged cell + newline lost
fp8-int8-ref: "Notes: Senior eng\nBob: Relocated 2020"  <-- preserved
```
Deepak Rao: can you paste the eval command you ran?
Alice Nguyen: `./eval/run_tablex.sh --model awq-fp8-compact-v2 --dataset legal-csv-1000 --batch 8 --seed 43 --metrics em,struct-halluc`
Ben Kim: did you try turning off prefix KV cache? sometimes fp8 path + cache causes token blending.
Alice Nguyen: toggled cache off, still spike but smaller (3.6%).
Emily Zhang: any difference across long vs short sequences? maybe kernel rounding accumulates with long multi-line cells.
Alice Nguyen: shorter samples (<=128 tokens) show <1% halluc. long ones (>512) spike.
Ciara Patel: tentative plan: 1) run bisect between quant configs (scale vs per-channel), 2) run deterministic seed matrix, 3) generate token-level diffs.
Deepak Rao: I'll spin up a parallel sweep on dedicated GPUs. assigning @ciara and @ben for diffs.
quant-bot: Sweep job 6123 started on pool-dedicated-8xA100. ETA ~ 2h. Logs: https://internal.redwood/sweeps/6123
Alice Nguyen: adding a small repro prompt and golden output to the thread for easier triage. sharing gist in a sec.
Ben Kim: also test GPTQ baseline and AWQ without compact quant params. want to know if compact encoding is the trigger.
Alice Nguyen: noted. I'll attach run artifacts + token diffs after sweep completes. thanks :thumbsup:
quant-bot: Sweep job 6123 completed. Results: awq-fp8-compact-v2 hall rate 4.9%, awq-fp8-standard 1.1%, gptq-int8 0.7%. Artifacts: https://internal.redwood/sweeps/6123/artifacts
Emily Zhang: interesting — compact encoding seems the culprit. next: try modified scale clipping and fallback tokens for newline escapes.
Ciara Patel: I'll open a small PR to add a newline-preserving postprocess in the runner as a quick mitigation.
Alice Nguyen: timeline: if mitigation works, hotfix to dedicated profile before next rollout. will update here.
